kept.title: Sidewalk clearing can take about 12 hours after a snowfall
kept.detail: The City starts clearing sidewalks once 2 cm of snow has built up. A full clearing cycle takes about 12 hours, so sidewalks may not yet be cleared for late-night or early-morning walks soon after snow. The data does not show whether nearby stops are on the TTC priority list for clearing.

cites.quote: the City begins sidewalk clearing once snow accumulation reaches 2 cm
City crews typically complete a full sidewalk clearing cycle within approximately 12 hours once accumulation reaches 2 cm

kept.title: Laneways are salted but not plowed
kept.detail: Under the City's winter rules, public laneways are not plowed. They are only salted, within 24 hours after snow stops. Any walking route that uses a laneway may have snow or ice on it.

cites.quote: salting only, within 24 hours after the end of snowfall, to manage icy conditions; snow plowing is not provided
